## F17.auto-routing — Automatic routing

Definition: The product choosing or switching models itself. (lever class: model)
- claude-code [supported, verified] When the primary model is overloaded or unavailable, a session with fallbackModel set switches to the backup and retries the primary at the start of each user turn. opusplan applies during plan mode when allowed by availableModels, then switches to Sonnet for execution. Omitted subagent models follow the subagent model order. | ev: E-claude-code-00284, E-claude-code-00159, E-claude-code-00826
- codex-cli [supported, verified] The service can route a request to another model and reports it with a model/rerouted notification carrying threadId, turnId, fromModel, toModel and reason. Codex cloud selects its model automatically. | ev: E-codex-cli-00324, E-codex-cli-02358
- copilot-cli [supported, verified] Auto chooses models from real-time system health and availability, model performance and task complexity. /model auto TIER (efficiency, balance, or intelligence) selects an Auto routing tier directly. When a setting is true, eligible rate limit errors trigger an automatic switch to auto mode and retry; this does not apply to global rate limits or BYOK providers. | ev: E-copilot-cli-00369, E-copilot-cli-00900, E-copilot-cli-01218, E-copilot-cli-00236
- copilot-vscode [supported, verified] Auto model selection evaluates task complexity and real-time model availability to route each request to the optimal model, combining a model health and availability system with a task-complexity system. chat.subagents.defaultToAuto (default false) makes subagents use Auto when no model is specified; the autoTier managed setting chooses how new chats initially optimize routing. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-00175, E-copilot-vscode-00385, E-copilot-vscode-01018, E-copilot-vscode-01056
- cursor [partial, verified] Cursor Router is the model routing system behind Auto: simple requests go to fast, efficient models while complex work goes to the most capable ones. Definition: Other providers, gateways and custom endpoints. (lever class: model)
- claude-code [supported, verified] Claude Code connects to Amazon Bedrock (login wizard under 3rd-party platform), Microsoft Foundry (three authentication methods), Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Claude Platform on AWS and LLM gateways. allowedProviders limits which API providers a machine may use; a session on an unlisted provider is refused (requires v2.1.285 or later). | ev: E-claude-code-01969, E-claude-code-02169, E-claude-code-00417, E-claude-code-00133
- codex-cli [supported, verified] Custom model providers define base URL, wire API, authentication and optional HTTP headers, and can't reuse the reserved IDs openai, ollama or lmstudio. model_provider picks a provider id from model_providers (default openai). - copilot-cli [supported, verified] Copilot CLI can use your own model provider instead of GitHub-hosted models (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Azure OpenAI or Anthropic, including local models such as Ollama), set up with environment variables.
